comment: The HTTP caching test suite's entity-tag conditional request tests, byte for byte at the pinned commit: the validation oracle for evaluating If-None-Match against a held entity tag (RFC 9110 sections 8.8.3.2 and 13.1.2). The suite states each case for a cache holding a fresh response; RFC 9110 section 13.1.2 gives a cache and an origin server the same evaluation. Held here: every test that the suite marks required or optimal and that states a held ETag, a received If-None-Match and an expected status, with no other request condition (5 distinct cases; the tests the suite marks 'check' record behaviour it does not require and are left out). generators/transition's storecache reads the cases from the file; generators/snapshot's lockcheck holds the file and the licence to the hashes below.
standard: RFC 9110 HTTP Semantics, IETF; RFC 9111 HTTP Caching, IETF
